Hi, I’m Nick. I’ve worked in tech for over 20 years, and after being made redundant at the end of 2025, I finally started the blog I’ve been planning since the beginning of my career.
The blog will focus on:
Homelab — self-hosting, servers, networking, and my favourite money pit Home Automation — using Home Assistant and Loxone to seamlessly spend my life debugging my house AI — self-hosting LLMs on local hardware Garden Irrigation — building and automating a garden watering setup Home Cinema — budget-friendly home cinema 3D Printing — hopefully without creating a ton of plastic waste If any of that sounds interesting, subscribe via RSS or find me on GitHub.
title: Welcome
